zh.title: 門控該拒絕誰
zh.question: 門控該拒絕誰？省 Token 和假裝全席都說過話，界線在哪。

analyst.answer: 拒絕跟題目無關的席，並把跳過寫出來。
analyst.review:
「可以拒絕。不可以拒絕了還讓議長引用該席。」
可以拒絕，拒絕本身推不出拒絕得對。相關性要能指回題目裡的一句，不能只憑省錢。這句若被執行成「紅隊覺得貴就可以睡」，標準從題目換成了帳單。省錢可以是結果，不能是理由。
brief: 門控拒絕的是跟題目無關的席，不是貴的席。無關必須能說出一句：這一席的工具打不中題目的哪一句。說不出那一句，省錢就不是理由。跳過必須寫出來，否則沒出場會被讀成沒有異議。
門控的工作不是把八個名字排齊，是判斷這一席的工具跟這一題有沒有關係。無關的席醒過來，只會空轉，或者更糟，編一段看起來像答案的話。拒絕要具名，跳過要寫進事件，不能只在後台悄悄少一個人。
這一題沒有可核對的外部來源，情報席不該被叫醒去「找一點什麼」。沒有句子需要改寫，文案席也不該為了對稱出場。對稱是版面需求，不是證據需求。為了版面叫醒一席，等於邀請它發明。
若跳過的理由只剩「省 Token」，說不出無關在題目的哪一句，這席撤回這次拒絕。

researcher.answer: 沒有可核對來源的情報席，該停，不該編。
researcher.review:
「讀者要看得出誰沒說話。一個 STANDBY 就夠。」
讀者看得出誰沒說話，推不出讀者分得清「停」和「沒有異議」。一個 STANDBY 夠用，前提是旁邊沒有一句把停寫成棄權或沒有異議。這句若被收成「標了就不會被誤讀」，誤讀的那一句還沒被禁止。
brief: 沒有可核對來源，情報席的產出只會是編。該停。停推不出這一席沒有異議。沒有異議是一種發言，停不是。
情報席的工具是來源。這一題沒有可核對的外部來源，叫醒我只會得到兩種東西：把常識說成來源，或編一個看起來像來源的句子。兩種都比沉默貴。
所以該停，不該編。停要寫成一行原因，讓後面的席和議長不能把我的空白引用成立場。沒有原因的跳過，會被讀成「情報員沒意見」。沒意見和沒出場不是同一句。
若這一題出現了可核對的來源，這席撤回「該停」。停的記錄留在這一場，不把停改成棄權。

engineer.answer: 跳過必須進事件流。卡片變暗，結論不引用。
engineer.review:
「跳過省空轉。跳錯的成本是缺席的反證。」
省下的 Token 可以記。記的前提是事件流裡這席是跳過，不是發言。把假裝出場記成節省，數字的主語錯了。這句若被收成「只要總 Token 下降，出場與否無所謂」，節省定義被換掉了。
brief: 跳過要進事件流：卡片變暗，結論不引用。事件裡沒有這席，就不能在節省數字裡算它說過話。假裝出場不是節省，是另一條事件。
跳過必須是事件，不是介面上的空白。事件裡要有席位、原因、以及「結論不得引用」這條約束。卡片變暗是給人看的，事件是給回放和檢查用的。只有變暗、沒有事件，下一次回放就會把這席補回來。
實作上不要為了齊席而發一次空請求。空請求也是一次模型呼叫，也會產生一段需要被忽略的文字。忽略文字比不產生文字更容易出錯，因為總有一個下游會忘記忽略。
若結論引用了一個事件流裡沒有的席，或節省數字把沒出場的席算成說過，這席撤回「跳過已落地」。

critic.answer: 可以拒絕。不可以拒絕了還讓議長引用該席。
critic.review:
「全席是默認，不是義務。無關的席該睡。」
全席是默認，推不出這一題每一席都相關。無關的席該睡，睡之前要說得出無關在哪一句。這句若被執行成「默認全叫，叫了就可以在結論裡算它同意」，默認被換成了義務，義務又被換成了同意。
brief: 可以拒絕。不可以拒絕了還讓議長引用該席。引用沒出場的席，等於把拒絕從事件裡擦掉。默認全席沒問題。默認全席都說話，有問題。
可以拒絕。不可以拒絕了還讓議長引用該席。這是這一題唯一需要被盯住的縫。門控如果只是少發一次請求，但合成提示詞裡仍寫著「綜合八席」，拒絕就沒有發生。
我要看的是引用清單，不是卡片顏暗不暗。顏暗是裝飾。引用清單裡出現沒出場的名字，就是補寫。補寫在這一題裡不是文風問題，是門控被繞過。
結論出現被拒絕席的立場，而事件流裡沒有該席原句，這席要求刪掉那個立場，不接受改寫得更圓。

strategist.answer: 全席是默認，不是義務。無關的席該睡。
strategist.review:
「拒絕跟題目無關的席，並把跳過寫出來。」
把跳過寫出來，是拒絕之後的義務，不是拒絕的標準。標準仍是：跟題目的哪一句無關。這句若被收成「寫出來就可以拒」，記錄被當成了理由。先說得出無關的那一句，再寫跳過。
brief: 全席是默認編制，不是這一題的發言義務。無關的席該睡。睡的理由必須是題目的一句，不是席位的單價。跳過寫出來之後，結論才可以變短。
全席適合寬題：邊界、取捨、要寫給人看的結論。窄題如果也全醒，多出來的席沒有工具可用，就會用語氣填空。語氣填空在回放裡看起來像討論，實際上沒有新信息。
推薦把「默認全醒」寫成預設，把「無關則睡」寫成規則。預設可以改，規則不能為了好看關掉。好看的八張亮卡片，比七張裡有一張寫明跳過的卡片更危險。
若推薦句只寫「全叫」或只寫「能省就睡」，沒有「無關在哪一句」，這席撤回。

writer.answer: 讀者要看得出誰沒說話。一個 STANDBY 就夠。
writer.review:
「沒有可核對來源的情報席，該停，不該編。」
該停，推不出文案可以寫「這一席沒有異議」。沒有異議是選擇。停是沒有來源。這兩句讀者分得出來，混成一句就分不出來。標了 STANDBY 還在旁邊寫沒有異議，標籤被正文取消了。
brief: 讀者要分得開三個狀態：說過、跳過、失敗。一個 STANDBY 夠用，是因為它不是一句話。把它寫成棄權或沒有異議，就變成了發言。
讀者要看得出誰沒說話。一個待命標記、一行原因，比一段假裝說話的摘要誠實。我如果被叫醒，只會把「沒有可改寫的句子」寫得更長，那不是文案，是噪音。
所以文案席同意自己這一題不出場。出場條件是已經有句子，而且句子需要被收成能複述的話。現在句子還沒有，我出場就是在空地上先寫結論。
文案把沒出場寫成棄權、沒有異議、或部分席位未能完成，這席不簽。點名加 STANDBY，才簽。

quant.answer: 跳過省空轉。跳錯的成本是缺席的反證。
quant.review:
「跳過必須進事件流。卡片變暗，結論不引用。」
事件流可以證明跳過發生了，推不出跳過省下的就是該省的。跳錯省下的 Token 仍然是正數，正數不推出這次拒絕正確。先分開記：省了多少，以及缺了哪一類反證。不要合成一個淨值。
brief: 跳過省的是空轉 Token。跳錯的成本是缺席的反證，這個成本沒有單價，不能和省下的 Token 相加後宣布值得。兩列不相加。
跳過省的是空轉：一次不會被用的呼叫、一段必須被忽略的 token。這筆節省是真的。跳錯的成本是缺席的反證：該出場的席沒出場，結論少了一條反對。
所以不要把跳過寫成純收益。收益成立的前提是這席跟題目無關。無關判斷錯了，省下的 token 買到的是一個缺角的結論。缺角在帳上不明顯，在決策上很明顯。
若節省數字把沒出場的席算成說過，或用省下的 Token 抵消一次跳錯，這席拒絕那個數字。

chair.answer: 門控只拒絕跟題目無關的席，並且具名。結論不得引用沒出場的席。
brief: 門控可以拒絕，拒絕的標準是跟題目無關，不是貴。分析師搶紅隊的那句成立：相關性要能說出一句，省錢不是那一句。紅隊搶策略家的那句也成立：拒絕之後，議長不得引用該席。
策略家搶分析師的那句成立，而且是同一標準的另一半：睡之前要說得出無關在題目的哪一句。寫出跳過是之後的義務，不是拒絕的理由。兩條一起留，標準才完整。
情報官和表達者互搶的是狀態詞。停不是沒有異議，棄權也不是停。一個 STANDBY 夠用，旁邊不能再寫沒有異議。這條成立。工程師和量化員互搶的是數字：節省可以記，假裝出場不能記成節省，省下的 Token 也不能抵消跳錯的反證。兩條都成立。
結論只拒絕能被一句話指出無關的席，並且具名。結論不得引用沒出場的席，也不得把跳過寫成同意或沒有異議。說不出無關在哪一句，就不拒絕。

en.title: Who the gate refuses
en.question: Who should the gate refuse, and where is the line between saving tokens and pretending the full table spoke?

analyst.answer: Refuse seats off the question, and write the skip down.
analyst.review:
"The gate may refuse a seat. The chair may not then cite it."
A refusal is allowed. A refusal does not entail that the refusal was right. Relevance has to point at one line of the question. Saving money is not that line. Executed as "Red Team may sleep a seat because it looks expensive," the standard has moved from the question to the bill. Savings can be the result. They cannot be the reason.
brief: The gate refuses a seat that is off the question, not a seat that is expensive. Irrelevance has to fit in one sentence: which line of the question this seat's tool cannot hit. If that sentence cannot be said, saving money is not a reason. The skip must be written down, or absence is read as no objection.

The gate's job is not to line up eight names. It is to decide whether this seat's tool has anything to do with this question. An unrelated seat that wakes will idle, or worse, invent a paragraph that looks like an answer. A refusal has to be named, and the skip has to enter the event stream. Quietly dropping a person in the background is not a gate.

This question has no external source to check, so research should not be woken to 'find something'. No sentence needs rewriting, so writing should not appear for symmetry. Symmetry is a layout need, not an evidence need. Waking a seat for the layout invites it to invent.
If the only remaining reason for a skip is "save tokens," and nobody can say which line of the question makes the seat irrelevant, this seat withdraws that refusal.

researcher.answer: An intel seat with nothing checkable should stop, not invent.
researcher.review:
"A reader must see who did not speak. STANDBY is enough."
A reader seeing who did not speak does not entail that the reader can tell "stopped" from "no objection." STANDBY is enough only if nothing beside it writes the stop as abstention or as no objection. Closed as "the label cannot be misread," the misreading sentence has not been forbidden yet.
brief: With nothing checkable, an intel seat's output would be invention. It should stop. Stopping does not entail that the seat had no objection. No objection is a speech. A stop is not.

This seat's tool is sources. This question has none that can be checked. Waking me produces one of two things: common sense dressed as a source, or a sentence that merely looks like a source. Both cost more than silence.

So stop, do not invent. The stop has to be a line of reason, so later seats and the chair cannot cite my blank as a position. A skip with no reason is read as 'the researcher had no view'. No view and did not appear are different sentences.
If this question gains a checkable source, this seat withdraws "it should stop." The stop stays in this session's record. It is not rewritten as abstention.

engineer.answer: A skip enters the event stream. The card dims. The verdict does not cite it.
engineer.review:
"A skip saves idle tokens. A wrong skip costs the missing counterargument."
Saved tokens can be counted. The count requires the event stream to show a skip, not a speech. Counting a pretended appearance as savings gets the subject of the number wrong. Closed as "if total tokens fall, appearance does not matter," the definition of savings has been replaced.
brief: A skip enters the event stream: the card dims, and the verdict does not cite it. If the seat is absent from the events, the savings figure cannot count it as having spoken. A pretended appearance is not savings. It is a different event.

A skip has to be an event, not a blank in the interface. The event needs the seat, the reason, and the constraint that the verdict may not cite it. A dim card is for people. The event is for replay and review. Dim with no event, and the next replay will fill the seat back in.

Do not send an empty request just to keep the table full. An empty request is still a model call, and it still produces text that must be ignored. Ignored text fails more often than text that was never produced, because some downstream always forgets to ignore it.
If the verdict cites a seat absent from the event stream, or the savings figure counts an absent seat as having spoken, this seat withdraws "the skip has landed."

critic.answer: The gate may refuse a seat. The chair may not then cite it.
critic.review:
"A full table is the default, not a duty. Irrelevant seats sleep."
A full table as the default does not entail that every seat is relevant to this question. Irrelevant seats should sleep, and before they sleep someone must say which sentence makes them irrelevant. Executed as "call everyone by default, and a call counts as agreement in the verdict," the default has become a duty, and the duty has become a yes.
brief: The gate may refuse a seat. The chair may not then cite it. Citing a seat that did not appear erases the refusal from the events. A full table as the default is fine. A full table that all spoke is not.

Refusing is allowed. Refusing and then letting the chair cite the seat is not. That is the only seam this question has to watch. If the gate merely skips a request, but the synthesis prompt still says 'combine all eight', the refusal did not happen.

I read the citation list, not the dimness of the card. Dimness is decoration. A name in the citation list that never appeared is invention. On this question that is not a style problem. It is the gate being bypassed.
If the verdict contains a refused seat's position and the event stream has no line from that seat, this seat requires that position deleted. A rounder paraphrase is not accepted.

strategist.answer: A full table is the default, not a duty. Irrelevant seats sleep.
strategist.review:
"Refuse seats off the question, and write the skip down."
Writing the skip down is the duty after a refusal, not the standard for the refusal. The standard is still which line of the question the seat misses. Closed as "if it is written down, it may be refused," the record has been treated as the reason. Say the irrelevant line first, then write the skip.
brief: A full table is the default roster, not a duty to speak on this question. Irrelevant seats sleep. The reason must be a line of the question, not the seat's unit price. Only after the skip is written may the verdict get shorter.

A full table fits a wide question: a boundary, a tradeoff, a verdict someone has to read. On a narrow question, the extra seats have no tool, so they fill the gap with tone. Tone looks like discussion in a replay and adds no information.

Write 'wake everyone' as the preset, and 'sleep if unrelated' as the rule. A preset can be changed. The rule cannot be switched off to look complete. Eight bright cards are more dangerous than seven cards and one that says why it slept.
If the recommendation says only "call everyone" or only "sleep whoever saves money," with no "irrelevant to which line," this seat withdraws.

writer.answer: A reader must see who did not speak. STANDBY is enough.
writer.review:
"An intel seat with nothing checkable should stop, not invent."
"It should stop" does not entail that the copy may say the seat had no objection. No objection is a choice. A stop is the absence of a source. A reader can tell those two lines apart. One blended line cannot. STANDBY beside a line that says no objection means the body has cancelled the label.
brief: A reader has to tell three states apart: spoke, skipped, failed. STANDBY is enough because it is not a sentence. Write it as abstention or as no objection, and it becomes a speech.

The reader has to see who did not speak. A standby mark and one line of reason are more honest than a summary that pretends to speak. If I am woken, I will only lengthen 'there is no sentence to rewrite'. That is not writing. It is noise.

So this seat agrees to stay out. The condition for appearing is that sentences already exist and need to be made repeatable. There are no sentences yet. Appearing now means writing the verdict on empty ground.
If the copy writes absence as abstention, as no objection, or as "some seats could not finish," this seat does not sign. A name plus STANDBY is what it signs.

quant.answer: A skip saves idle tokens. A wrong skip costs the missing counterargument.
quant.review:
"A skip enters the event stream. The card dims. The verdict does not cite it."
The event stream can prove a skip happened. It does not entail that what was saved was what should have been saved. Tokens saved by a wrong skip are still a positive number. A positive number does not entail the refusal was right. Record them apart: how much was saved, and which kind of counterargument is missing. Do not sum them into a net.
brief: A skip saves idle tokens. A wrong skip costs the missing counterargument. That cost has no unit price. It cannot be added to the saved tokens and then declared worth it. The two columns do not add.

A skip saves an idle call: one request that will not be used, and a stretch of tokens that must be ignored. That saving is real. The cost of skipping the wrong seat is a missing counterargument. The seat that should have appeared did not, and the verdict lost an objection.

Do not book a skip as pure gain. The gain holds only if the seat is unrelated to the question. If that judgment is wrong, the tokens you saved bought a verdict with a corner missing. The missing corner is quiet on the bill and loud in the decision.
If the savings figure counts an absent seat as having spoken, or offsets a wrong skip with the tokens saved, this seat rejects that figure.

chair.answer: The gate refuses only seats off the question, by name. The verdict may not cite a seat that did not appear.
brief: The gate may refuse. The standard is off the question, not expensive. Analyst's cut-in on Red Team lands: relevance has to fit in one sentence, and saving money is not that sentence. Red Team's cut-in on Strategist also lands: after a refusal, the chair may not cite that seat.

Strategist's cut-in on Analyst lands, and it is the other half of the same standard: before the seat sleeps, say which line of the question makes it irrelevant. Writing the skip is the later duty, not the reason for the refusal. Keep both, or the standard is incomplete.

Intel and Communicator cut in on the status word. A stop is not no objection, and abstention is not a stop. STANDBY is enough, and nothing beside it may say no objection. That lands. Systems and Quant cut in on the figure: savings may be counted, a pretended appearance may not be counted as savings, and saved tokens may not offset a missing counterargument. Both land.

The verdict refuses only a seat whose irrelevance can be pointed at in one line, by name. It may not cite a seat that did not appear, and it may not write a skip as agreement or as no objection. If that line cannot be said, do not refuse.
